summary: Adds a floating Work Panel, simplifies agent navigation, and refines dark surfaces and chat permissions.

items.title: Floating Work Panel
items.description: The panel brings together a shared workspace picker, live Sources and Git changes, direct links to Review, the latest Task Plan, and context usage. It adjusts around the sidebars and uses compact Proxy controls when space is limited.

items.title: Work Panel agent navigation
items.description: Work Panel navigation replaces the header agent tabs and includes Switch to main. Nested agents open the existing Swarm panel. When a worker delegates, the section shows Go to Swarm panel and opens the hierarchical view. Auto-open Work Panel defaults to on, and generated agent names target 24 characters.

items.title: Previous agents
items.description: Finished workers and their durations appear in a collapsed Previous agents section. Long lists scroll within the panel.

items.title: Dark interface surfaces
items.description: The dark chat feed, title bar, and splash screen use pure black, while the sidebar uses near-black and preserves the Recent chats panel shading. The chat input uses a #0E0E0E fill, a subtle one-pixel #1A1A1A outline, and a faint inner highlight.

items.title: Chat permission controls
items.description: The permission dropdown has a clearer interface. Permission changes apply only to the selected chat and can be paused during a run.

items.title: Accurate live diff counts
items.description: Small page.tsx edits no longer appear as a near-total replacement such as +12,917/−12,913. Edits far apart appear as separate hunks, and counts use the versions the agent actually committed. Long diffs display 250 rows at a time. Older chats recover accurate counts when both versions were saved; if a comparison exceeds the work limit, its count stays unavailable.
